alert.headline: Special Marine Warning issued July 27 at 2:16PM CDT until July 27 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI

alerts.headline: Special Marine Warning issued July 27 at 2:16PM CDT until July 27 at 4:45PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
alerts.description:
SMWMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore waters from Sheboygan WI to Winthrop Harbor IL...
Lake Michigan from Port Washington WI to Winthrop Harbor IL...

* Until 445 PM CDT.

* At 216 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 25 nm east of Wind Pt. to Bayside, moving south at
20 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and large hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves. Large hail could result in
structural damage.

* Severe thunderstorms will remain over mainly open waters.
